input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: § 12.4 binds only the Customer and is squarely in walk-away territory: it is a no-hire (not merely a non-solicit), runs 24 months post-term, covers any Vendor employee rather than only personnel involved in the Services, and expressly negates any general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out ("regardless of how the employee applies"). It also conflicts with § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no no-hire commitment. Per the redline guidance we narrowed it to the fallback with minimal edits: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of that involvement, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and the no-hire deleted.

proposal.summary: Narrow one-way 24-month no-hire to a mutual 12-month non-solicit of involved personnel with customary carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a one-way no-hire covering every Vendor employee for 24 months, particularly as § 12.3 confirms we have given no no-hire commitment; we have made the restriction mutual, limited it to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months, and added the customary general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.

ops.oldText: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: 12.4 Neither party shall directly solicit for employment any personnel of the other party who are directly involved in performing or receiving the Services, for twelve months following the end of that individual's involvement in the Services. This restriction does not apply to general advertisements or other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or to unsolicited approaches by an individual, and neither party is restricted from hiring or engaging any person who responds to such general recruitment or approaches the other party on an unsolicited basis.
